label: 86 Chaos 16.0.243
notes: Generates dedicated testing-only SYSTEM_ADMIN, OWNER, MANAGER, and STAFF credential pairs in the parent release-gate process when auto-provisioning is enabled and no pair was configured.
Refuses partially configured role pairs, preserves fully configured pairs, uses cryptographic random passwords, and never prints generated passwords.

Full Play Store certification is not limited to 20 individual tests. Each certification execution runs the complete configured test universe; the 20-execution cap applies only to this current repair cycle.
